## Done

Split `cart/hmsc-workspace-mock/FileExplorerDialog.tsx` (409 lines) into 8 one-component-per-file modules under `cart/editor/dialogs/`. Render output, prop signatures, classifier usage, and inline dynamic styling preserved verbatim. Each file is a single `export default function` — no barrel, no multi-export.

### Sub-components split out (7 + parent)
The source contained `FileExplorerDialog` plus these sub-components: `ExplorerTree`, `ExplorerTreeNode`, `FileResultRow`, `ModelImportPreview`, `FilePreview`, `DirectoryMemory`, `HistoryStrip`.

### Files and their props interfaces
- **`/home/siah/creative/reactjit/cart/editor/dialogs/FileExplorerDialog.tsx`** — parent. `Props` = `{ query: string; selectedFolder: ExplorerFolderId; expandedFolders: Partial<Record<ExplorerFolderId, boolean>>; selectedFileId: string; history: ExplorerHistoryEntry[]; folderHistory: ExplorerDirectoryHistoryEntry[]; onQuery; onFolder; onToggleFolder; onSelectFile; onOpenFile; onClose }`. Keeps the `RESULT_SLOTS` const + `rankFile`/`visibleFiles` helpers as local non-exported functions. Imports its sub-components by path.
- **`/home/siah/creative/reactjit/cart/editor/dialogs/ExplorerTree.tsx`** — `{ selectedFolder; expandedFolders; onFolder; onToggleFolder }` (the expanded `Pick<Props,…>`). Imports `ExplorerTreeNode`.
- **`/home/siah/creative/reactjit/cart/editor/dialogs/ExplorerTreeNode.tsx`** — `{ folder: ExplorerFolder; depth: number; selectedFolder; expandedFolders; onFolder; onToggleFolder }`. Recursive (self-reference); holds the local `folderCount` helper.
- **`/home/siah/creative/reactjit/cart/editor/dialogs/FileResultRow.tsx`** — `{ file: ExplorerFile; active: boolean; recent: boolean; onSelectFile; onOpenFile }`.
- **`/home/siah/creative/reactjit/cart/editor/dialogs/ModelImportPreview.tsx`** — `{ file: ExplorerFile }`.
- **`/home/siah/creative/reactjit/cart/editor/dialogs/FilePreview.tsx`** — `{ file: ExplorerFile; query: string; onOpenFile }`. Imports `ModelImportPreview`.
- **`/home/siah/creative/reactjit/cart/editor/dialogs/DirectoryMemory.tsx`** — `{ history: ExplorerDirectoryHistoryEntry[]; selectedFolder; onFolder }`.
- **`/home/siah/creative/reactjit/cart/editor/dialogs/HistoryStrip.tsx`** — `{ history: ExplorerHistoryEntry[]; onOpenFile }`.

### Import conventions applied
`import { C, accentFor } from '../workspace.cls'`, explorer data from `'../data/fileExplorer'` (the source's `./fileExplorerData` is named `fileExplorer.ts` in the editor cart), Icon from `'../../../runtime/icons/Icon'`.

- `tools/esbuild cart/editor/dialogs/FileExplorerDialog.tsx --bundle … --alias:@reactjit=runtime` → exit 0, clean (294.8kb).
- Sub-components `FilePreview.tsx` and `ExplorerTree.tsx` also bundle clean (exit 0).
